questions.question: Which hand normally operates the bellows in the Akshara Fine Arts beginner method?
questions.explanation: The left hand normally operates the bellows while the right hand plays the keyboard.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-001

questions.question: Which hand normally plays the Harmonium keyboard?
questions.explanation: In the standard beginner method, the right hand plays the keyboard.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-002

questions.question: Which number represents the right-hand middle finger?
questions.explanation: Finger 3 is the middle finger.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-003

questions.question: Which shoulder position is correct while operating the bellows?
questions.explanation: A relaxed shoulder supports smooth bellows movement and reduces tension.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-004

questions.question: How should a Grade 1 student move the bellows?
questions.explanation: Smooth, gentle movement creates more stable airflow.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-005

questions.question: Which black-key groups repeat across the keyboard?
questions.explanation: Black keys appear in repeating groups of two and three.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-006

questions.question: How should the fingers generally be positioned over the keys?
questions.explanation: Naturally curved fingers support control and relaxed playing.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-007

questions.question: Where should the Harmonium normally be placed?
options: Comfortably in front of the student
questions.explanation: The instrument should be comfortably in front so both hands can work without twisting.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-008

questions.question: On a standard keyboard, moving towards the right generally produces what?
questions.explanation: Keyboard pitch normally rises as the player moves to the right.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-009

questions.question: Moving towards the left side of the keyboard generally produces what?
questions.explanation: Keyboard pitch normally becomes lower towards the left.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-010

questions.question: Which number represents the little finger?
questions.explanation: Finger 5 is the little finger.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-011

questions.question: What may happen when the bellows are pushed with excessive pressure?
options: The sound may become too loud or harsh
questions.explanation: Excessive air pressure can make the sound unnecessarily loud or harsh.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-012

questions.question: What may happen when the bellows pressure is too weak?
options: The sound may become faint or unstable
questions.explanation: Insufficient airflow can make the sound weak or unstable.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-013

questions.question: How should a beginner press a Harmonium key?
options: Gently and fully enough to sound the note
questions.explanation: The key should be pressed clearly without unnecessary force.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-014

questions.question: Which number represents the index finger?
questions.explanation: Finger 2 is the index finger.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-015

questions.question: Which item should be kept away from the Harmonium?
questions.explanation: Liquids can damage the wooden body, keys, and internal reeds.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-016

questions.question: What must continue while a note is being sustained?
questions.explanation: A sustained Harmonium sound requires continuous airflow.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-017

questions.question: Which sitting position is best for beginner practice?
questions.explanation: A naturally upright posture supports breathing, balance, and relaxed hand movement.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-018

questions.question: Which description is correct?
options: Keyboard contains white and black keys
questions.explanation: A Harmonium keyboard normally contains both white and black keys.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-019

questions.question: What should the student do before playing the teacher's Sa?
options: Listen carefully to the teacher's pitch
questions.explanation: Listening first helps the student locate and match the correct Sa.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-020

questions.question: What is the main function of the bellows?
questions.explanation: The bellows supply the air required to create sound.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-021

questions.question: What does the keyboard help the player select?
questions.explanation: Different keys produce different pitches.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-022

questions.question: Which number represents the ring finger?
questions.explanation: Finger 4 is the ring finger.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-023

questions.question: Which two actions are required to produce a normal Harmonium note?
options: Closing the lid and pressing a stop
Supplying air and pressing a key
questions.explanation: Air activates the reeds while the pressed key selects the pitch.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-024

questions.question: Which number represents the thumb?
questions.explanation: Finger 1 is the thumb.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-025

questions.question: What should happen immediately before the first key is pressed?
questions.explanation: Gentle airflow should be prepared so the first note begins clearly.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-026

questions.question: Which student shows the better posture?
questions.explanation: Upright and relaxed posture supports comfortable technique.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-027

questions.question: A student presses Sa correctly, but the sound stops after two counts. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanation: When airflow stops, the reed can no longer sustain the sound.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-028

questions.question: If Sa = E, which key is Pa?
questions.explanation: Pa is seven semitones above Sa. When Sa is E, Pa is B.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-029

questions.question: If Sa = G, which key is Pa?
questions.explanation: Pa is seven semitones above Sa. When Sa is G, Pa is D.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-030

questions.question: A student's sound becomes louder and softer repeatedly even though the same key is held. What is a likely reason?
questions.explanation: Uneven bellows movement can cause repeated volume changes.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-031

questions.question: What is the best correction for a wrist that has collapsed towards the keyboard?
questions.explanation: A neutral wrist supports freer finger movement and reduces strain.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-032

questions.question: The student must stretch the right arm fully to reach the keys. What should be corrected?
options: Move the Harmonium to a comfortable distance
Change Sa from E to G
questions.explanation: The keyboard should be within comfortable reach without arm strain.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-033

questions.question: When should the student prepare to change the bellows direction?
options: Before available movement is fully exhausted
questions.explanation: Planning the reversal early helps preserve continuous sound.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-034

questions.question: The teacher sings Sa, but the student presses a different key. What should the student do first?
options: Stop, listen again, and compare pitch
questions.explanation: The student should listen and compare before trying again.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-035

questions.question: Which count is the most suitable beginner pulse?
questions.explanation: Grade 1 students should maintain an even four-count pulse.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-036

questions.question: What should the left hand do while the right hand moves from Sa to Pa?
questions.explanation: Airflow must continue while the right hand changes keys.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-037

questions.question: Why should a beginner avoid lifting the fingers very high above the keyboard?
options: It creates unnecessary movement and reduces control
questions.explanation: Keeping the fingers close to the keys improves efficiency and control.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-038

questions.question: A student raises the left shoulder every time the bellows are closed. What is the best correction?
options: Relax shoulder and use controlled arm movement
questions.explanation: The shoulder should remain relaxed while the arm controls the bellows.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-039

questions.question: What should the student do before covering and storing the Harmonium?
options: Place a drink on the lid
Close carefully according to the teacher's method
questions.explanation: Careful closing protects the bellows, keys, and body.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-040

questions.question: Which swara is commonly used with Sa to establish the basic Saâ€“Pa relationship?
questions.explanation: Sa and Pa form an important stable tonal relationship.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-041

questions.question: What should a Grade 1 student do before pulling an unfamiliar stop?
questions.explanation: Different Harmoniums have different stops, so beginners should use them under teacher guidance.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-042

questions.question: Why must a pitch question state the selected Sa?
options: Western key for each swara depends on tonic
Every white key is always Pa
questions.explanation: Swara positions move when the selected tonic changes.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-043

questions.question: A key is pressed fully, but no sound is produced. The instrument is otherwise functioning normally. Which action should be checked first?
options: Whether key is white or black
Whether air is supplied through bellows
questions.explanation: A Harmonium note requires airflow as well as a pressed key.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-044

questions.question: If Madhya Sa is E, where is the next upper Sa?
questions.explanation: Upper Sa is the same note name one octave higher.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-045

questions.question: A student sustains Sa. The note begins clearly, becomes very loud, then stops suddenly. Which explanation is best?
options: Pressure became excessive and direction change was late
questions.explanation: Excessive pressure explains the loudness, while a late reversal can cause the sudden stop.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-046

questions.question: A student leans sideways, raises the left shoulder, and pumps the bellows quickly. Which correction is best?
options: Re-centre body, relax shoulder, and slow bellows
questions.explanation: The correction addresses body alignment, shoulder tension, and uneven bellows movement together.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-047

questions.question: Which task is not appropriate as a compulsory Grade 1 assessment?
questions.explanation: Independent Kalpana Swara accompaniment belongs to an advanced grade.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-048

questions.question: The teacher sustains a soft Sa. Which Grade 1 Harmonium response is most suitable?
options: Match Sa softly with steady airflow
questions.explanation: Grade 1 accompaniment begins by matching and sustaining the teacher's tonic softly.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-049

questions.question: Which practice sequence is most appropriate for a Grade 1 beginner?
options: Play fast, select chords, then locate Sa
Sit correctly, prepare airflow, locate Sa, and play slowly
Begin advanced songs and correct posture later
Pull every stop and press several keys
questions.explanation: Correct posture and airflow must be established before slow, accurate playing begins.
questions.source: Akshara Fine Arts Official Bank â€” H-G1-050
